title: Holdout split custody assignment
description: A frozen, custodian-owned division of the paper corpus into a development side and a holdout side, bound to the inputs it was computed over. Structural validation only: the cross-field invariants (disjoint sides, at least 20% of papers held out, exact corpus coverage) and the salted commitment are enforced by jev_classifier.holdout, because a JSON Schema cannot express them.

frozen_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC instant at which the split was frozen, before any tuning.

custodian.description: Who owns the split and authorizes evaluator access.

inputs.description: Binds the freeze to what was frozen, e.g. {"papers": "sha256:...", "annotation_schema": "sha256:..."}.

holdout_paper_ids.description: At least two papers (MINIMUM_HOLDOUT_PAPERS) and at least 20% of the corpus; the fraction is checked by the validator.
